VBO:0200768.summary: Gentle and affectionate, the Ruby King Charles Spaniel is a happy toy companion that can be reserved rather than immediately outgoing. Its royal name was retained at King Edward VII’s urging. In 1945 the Kennel Club separated King Charles and Cavalier spaniels, keeping this compact toy branch distinct; Ruby is one of its four maintained colours.
VBO:0200768.shortDescription: A gentle, affectionate royal toy spaniel with a reserved streak; Ruby is one of four maintained colours.

Historical little gundogs became treasured pets in England/Continent; unsupported genetic causal detail excluded. Refined compact cobby adult3.6–6.3kg; large developed domed skull/short wide deep turned-up muzzle/wide-open nostrils/large dark eyes/low long feathered ears. Short straight forelimbs, muscular bent stifles/low hocks/compact round cat paws. Long silky straight/slightwave coat nevercurly. Full undocked feathered tail expressly allowed, notover/aboveback, balanced length; bobtail tolerated but not selected. VBO:0200769.summary: An affectionate, gentle companion with a reserved streak, the Tricolour King Charles Spaniel belongs to the same royal toy-spaniel breed as the Ruby. Toy spaniels were treasured as pets in England and on the Continent; their history reaches back to little gundogs. Today the Tricolour remains one of four colour varieties under a shared standard.
